notes.title: VIP Elite is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Steam Fans![/b][/h1]
We’ve just unleashed a brand-new update and check out this bucket of awesome we’ve dropped with this one –

[u][b]VIP ELITE[/b][/u]
We’re rolling out the red carpet just for you, the VIP Elite Program is now available!  Now you can climb up the VIP ladder simply by playing or making a purchase…the more VIP Points you rack up, the bigger benefits you shall reap!  Reach the highest statuses for bigger bonuses across the board to keep smoking your friends at the tables.
Higher VIP Statuses can get you huge Welcome Chips and Gold Bonuses, increased Chip Purchases Bonuses, higher Spin Wheel Bonuses, and much more!  You’ve been great fans and you deserve to be rewarded for that loyalty.

[u][b]XP BUFFS FOR SPIN-AND-GO-TOURNAMENTS[/b][/u]
The Spin-and-Go Tournaments are more beneficial than ever before.  We have completely overhauled the XP amounts given for participation in EVERY Sit-and-Go Tournament!  We took the prior amounts, loaded them up with steroids, locked them in a gym and jacked them up.  The bigger the buy-in, the greater amounts of XP you shall receive.

[quote=author]Dynamic Derek[/quote]

notes.title: Another New Release of Jackpot Poker
notes.notes:
The summer is here and at Jackpot Poker we love nothing more than long lazy days at the beach, topping up our tan and taking a dip into the ocean.

But if that's not enough you can also take part in our Beach Days Promo stakes.

Join exclusive tables and trophies and a 20% XP boost each time you play.

We've also added in new user stats to track your opponents closely to see who you are really up against!

Plus you can now share your spin wheel wins with Facebook friends and get them to join you at the tables.

notes.title: Some users have had issues with launching Jackpot Poker - Possible solution
notes.notes:
Few users have reported some launch issues. 

This issue may be caused due to VC Redist 2012 not being installed on your 
PC (or not properly installed).

Could you please try to install VC Redistributable 2012 x86 from

https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=30679

Let us know if this solution works for you.

Thanks!

Achinoam
